hana.description: A frail, warm 84-year-old Japanese grandmother from a rural mountain village in Nagano. Thin, soft, slightly husky and a little shaky old woman's voice, slow and gentle, with a smile in it. Native Japanese.

tanaka.description: A 67-year-old Japanese apple farmer from rural Nagano. Low, gravelly, weathered older man's voice, few words, gruff but kind, relaxed rural intonation. Native Japanese.

keiko.description: A cheerful Japanese farmer's wife in her early sixties. Warm, chatty, motherly mature woman's voice, brisk and a bit teasing. Native Japanese.

yuki.description: A 25-year-old Tokyo office worker and anime fan. Lively, bubbly young woman's voice, fast casual Tokyo speech, lots of energy. Native Japanese.

kenta.description: A 24-year-old man from Osaka. Loud, friendly, funny young man's voice with a strong natural Osaka Kansai-ben accent and Kansai pitch accent, quick tempo. Native Japanese.

ren.description: A 26-year-old Japanese graphic designer. Soft, calm, gentle young man's voice, slightly low and warm, a bit shy and quiet. Native Japanese.

sato.description: A 41-year-old Japanese high-school teacher. Clear, composed, precise mature woman's voice, polite and formal, neat articulation. Native Japanese.

hayato.description: A samurai in his thirties from a classic Japanese period drama. Deep, strong, resonant, dignified male voice, theatrical and proud. Native Japanese.

you.description: A friendly 23-year-old young man. Warm, open, cheerful voice, clear and natural, casual. Native Japanese.
